name: email-mcp
description: Multi-service email platform supporting SMTP/IMAP, SendGrid, Mailgun, Resend, local testing, webhook integrations, draft management, and AI-assisted writing

smtp_password.title: SMTP Password/App Password

imap_password.title: IMAP Password/App Password
